papers.title_en: SymbolicLM: Training Language Models as Symbolic Regressors
papers.authors: Jun Yao, Yingfan Hua, Ruikun Li, Shixiang Tang, Bin Liu, Wanli Ouyang, Yan Lu
papers.evidence: 通过数值-符号与物理监督将语言模型训练为符号回归器
papers.tldr: 科学发现需从观测数据推导精确定律，但大语言模型的概率生成与符号回归的结构要求存在鸿沟，现有方法依赖昂贵外部脚手架。提出PhysSymbArena基准，含超16万方程和18亿词元数值-符号数据，并训练SymbolicLM，以数学物理监督赋予其符号回归能力。推理时提出SymbolicSGA，用定量反馈迭代精炼方程。多基准实验显示，SymbolicLM显著提升结构恢复，保持有竞争力数值拟合，证明符号回归可作为大语言模型内在能力被显式学习。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promising capabilities in scientific reasoning, yet scientific discovery ultimately requires deriving precise laws directly from observational data, known as Symbolic Regression (SR). This poses a challenge for LLMs due to the gap between probabilistic text generation and the exact structural requirements of SR. Existing approaches rely on complex external scaffolds, which are computationally expensive and separate symbolic reasoning from the model itself. To address this limitation, we propose to directly equip LLMs with symbolic regression capabilities through dedicated numerical-symbolic and physical supervision. We introduce PhysSymbArena, a large-scale benchmark containing over 160,000 equations and 1.8B tokens of numerical-symbolic data with physical descriptions, enabling systematic training and evaluation. Based on PhysSymbArena, we develop SymbolicLM, which enhances the symbolic regression ability of LLMs through mathematical and physical supervision. During inference, we further introduce SymbolicSGA, a refinement framework that leverages quantitative feedback to iteratively improve generated equations. Experiments on multiple symbolic regression benchmarks show that SymbolicLM substantially improves structural recovery while maintaining competitive numerical fitting performance. These results demonstrate that symbolic regression can be explicitly learned as an intrinsic capability of LLMs.

papers.title_en: EvoMO-SR: Multiobjective LLM-based Evolution of Symbolic Expressions with substructure guidance
papers.authors: Cristina Rossetti, Anna V. Kononova, Thomas Bäck, Fei Liu, Niki Van Stein
papers.evidence: 大模型驱动的符号回归框架
papers.tldr: 符号回归能从数据中寻找可解释公式，但传统方法在搜索效率与表达式复杂度控制上难以兼顾。EvoMO-SR 让 LLM 生成方程骨架，外部优化器单独拟合系数，并用多目标生存选择平衡精度与复杂度、以子结构引导复用候选积木进行变异。在 LSR-Synth 的八种域内与域外设置中，仅用 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 便在七项取得最佳精度，且基于规范化子树重叠与项匹配的符号准确率表明更易恢复高精度结构。这显示小模型结合进化与结构引导可有效提升符号回归性能。
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic Regression (SR) is a data-driven method for scientific discovery which searches for interpretable analytical relationships within data. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have also had a significant impact on scientific discovery, enabling the automation of various stages of the process. For these reasons, the possibility of harnessing the embedded scientific knowledge and programming capabilities of LLMs to solve SR tasks has emerged, showing promising performance compared with traditional methods. We propose EvoMO-SR, a novel LLM-driven SR framework in which the LLM generates equation skeletons, with their coefficients fitted separately by an external optimizer. The framework includes a multi-objective survival selection which controls bloating by balancing accuracy and complexity, and a substructure guidance mechanism which mutates expressions with candidate reusable building blocks. EvoMO-SR achieves the best accuracy in seven of the eight in-domain and out-of-domain settings for LSR-Synth, using a small LLM model, i.e., Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. We also evaluated structural recovery through two symbolic accuracy metrics based on canonicalized subtree overlap and term matching, showing that our method has a greater probability of recovering highly accurate symbolic structures.

papers.title_en: Port-Hamiltonian Neural Networks for Systems with Multiple Asymptotically Stable Equilibria
papers.authors: Simon Heilig, Jens Püttschneider, Mohammad Itani, Asja Fischer, Timm Faulwasser
papers.evidence: 神经网络李雅普诺夫函数证明多平衡点稳定性
papers.tldr: 稳定端口哈密顿神经网络能以构造方式保证渐近稳定性，但其哈密顿量作为全局李雅普诺夫函数仅有一个全局极小值，因此只能表示单吸引子系统，连双井能量景观也无法覆盖。作者将哈密顿量参数化为由一个输入凸网络生成的 Bregman 散度乘积，从而支持多个渐近稳定平衡点。理论上证明了局部李雅普诺夫稳定性、稳定平衡点共存必然伴随额外非渐近稳定平衡点、所有平衡点位于有界区域，并在双曲性假设下几乎处处稳定。在三个系统上，该方法恢复能量面特征，并将收敛速度提升 1.8 至 8.5 倍。
papers.abstract_en: Stable port-Hamiltonian neural networks certify asymptotic stability by construction. Yet, their Hamiltonian is a global Lyapunov function with a single global minimum, so they can represent only dynamic systems with {one} attractor. We demonstrate that this excludes even simple systems with energy landscapes forming a double well, and we overcome the restriction by parametrising the Hamiltonian as a {product} of Bregman divergences generated by one input-convex network. We prove that the resulting model is locally Lyapunov stable, that the coexistence of stable equilibria forces additional non-asymptotically-stable equilibria to exist, that all equilibria lie in a bounded region, and under a hyperbolicity assumption that almost-everywhere stability holds. On three systems our approach is able to recover the energy surface characteristics and improve the convergence speed by 1.8$\times$-8.5$\times$.

papers.title_en: Practical Stabilization of Switched Affine Systems under Dwell Time: From Polytopic to p-Norm Lyapunov Functions
papers.authors: Felipe Cinto, Alexis J. Vallarella, Hernan Haimovich, Paulo C. Pellanda
papers.evidence: 切换仿射系统镇定的构造性李雅普诺夫刻画
papers.tldr: 针对期望工作点并非子系统共同平衡点的切换仿射系统，渐近稳定通常不可实现，目标是在最小驻留时间下使轨迹收敛并保持在指定区域。为此，本文建立加权 p-范数 Lyapunov 构造性刻画，推广二次等价，并面向多面体目标区域提出两步法：先求平均系统的多面体证书，再构造足够大 p 的光滑加权 p-范数函数。该扩展可保证期望点的实际渐近稳定，并给出驻留时间切换下的认证不变区域，数值算例验证了有效性。
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the stabilization of switched affine systems under dwell-time constraints around a desired operating point that is not a common equilibrium of the subsystems. Since asymptotic stabilization is generally unattainable in this setting, the objective is to ensure that trajectories converge to and remain within a prescribed region containing the desired operating point. The main contribution is the development of Lyapunov-based tools that accommodate target regions more general than those induced by quadratic Lyapunov functions. In particular, we establish a constructive Lyapunov characterization for a broad family of weighted $p$-norm functions, which generalizes the classical quadratic Lyapunov equivalence and underpins the proposed hybrid-control and dwell-time developments. Focusing on the case in which the desired region is a polytope, and building on existing Lyapunov-based methods, we develop a constructive two-step method that starts from a polytopic Lyapunov certificate for the average system and yields a smooth weighted $p$-norm Lyapunov function for all sufficiently large $p$. We prove that this extension guarantees practical asymptotic stability of the desired operating point and yields a Lyapunov-certified invariant region under minimum dwell-time switching. Numerical examples illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

papers.title_en: Fixed-Time ISS for Interconnected Discrete-Time Systems, Part II: Finite-Horizon Lyapunov Functions
papers.evidence: 用于离散时间系统稳定性的有限时域李雅普诺夫函数
papers.tldr: 针对受外源输入影响的离散时间互联系统，本文研究固定时间输入到状态稳定性（FxT-ISS）。提出有限时域Lyapunov函数，使初始条件影响在经过一致有界次迭代后被消除，涵盖已有消去型条件并允许更一般的有限记忆机制。进而建立有限时域小增益定理，给出反馈互联保持FxT-ISS的条件。该框架可支撑分布式算法、优化与反馈优化等示例，拓展了离散时间互联系统的稳定性分析工具。
papers.abstract_en: We study fixed-time input-to-state stability (FxT-ISS) for discrete-time systems subject to exogenous inputs using finite-horizon Lyapunov functions. In the proposed Lyapunov- based characterization, the effect of the initial condition is eliminated after a uniformly bounded number of iterations. This characterization encompasses existing extinction-based Lyapunov conditions while allowing more general finite-memory mechanisms. Building on this framework, we establish a finite-horizon small-gain theorem for interconnected discrete-time systems, providing conditions under which FxT-ISS is preserved under feedback interconnections. The proposed framework is illustrated through examples arising in distributed algorithms, optimization, and feedback optimization.

papers.title_en: Fixed-Time ISS for Interconnected Discrete-Time Systems, Part I: Extinction-Based Lyapunov Functions
papers.evidence: 基于李雅普诺夫函数的固定时间输入到状态稳定性
papers.tldr: 本文研究受外部输入影响的离散时间系统的固定时间输入到状态稳定性（FxT-ISS）。提出基于具有固定时间熄灭性质的耗散函数的Lyapunov充分条件，覆盖常用双幂构造，并允许更一般的衰减机制。进一步建立含扰动互联FxT-ISS系统的小增益定理。结果可用于扰动优化算法与离散时间反馈优化架构，拓展了固定时间稳定性分析。
papers.abstract_en: We study fixed-time input-to-state stability (FxT-ISS) for discrete-time systems subject to exogenous inputs. We introduce Lyapunov-based sufficient conditions for FxT- ISS based on a class of dissipation functions with a fixed-time extinction property, which encompasses commonly used two- power constructions while allowing substantially more general decay mechanisms. Building on this framework, we establish a small-gain theorem for interconnected FxT-ISS systems in the presence of disturbances. The results are illustrated through several examples, including perturbed optimization algorithms and a discrete-time feedback-optimization architecture.
